description: A format controller for the TD text displays with no knobs, setting text colour, background colour and text size from CV alone.

inputs.text: Sets the red part of the text colour, a tenth of its range per volt.
Sets the green part of the text colour, a tenth of its range per volt.
Sets the blue part of the text colour, a tenth of its range per volt.
Sets the red part of the background colour, a tenth of its range per volt.
Sets the green part of the background colour, a tenth of its range per volt.
Sets the blue part of the background colour, a tenth of its range per volt.
Sets the text size, two points per volt, clamped to between 6 and 26 points.

outputs.text: A port kept from an earlier version of the module; nothing is read from it or sent to it.

notes: the module formats a TD-116, TD-202 or TD-316 placed immediately to its left or its right, and does nothing on its own.
the link light comes on only beside a TD-202 or a TD-316, although a TD-116 also takes its formatting from this module.
menu: Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
